title: inga nobilis var. pavoniana
intro: Inga nobilis var. pavoniana, commonly known as the Pavon Inga tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Fabaceae, native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. This tree is valued for its medicinal properties, which include various health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, supporting cardiovascular health, wound healing, and immune system function. The therapeutic actions of Inga nobilis var. pavoniana are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which work to reduce oxidative stress, inflammation, and microbial infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been identified as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, including kaempferol, quercetin, and catechins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
